name: Impatient customer
behaviour: You are an impatient customer. Click the Pay button once, then click it again within one second because nothing seems to happen after the first click.

invariant.reason: A customer who has paid must end on the order confirmation page, not an empty cart.

notes: The second click happens while the first request is still in flight (the shop's payment step takes a moment). Do not wait for the confirmation page before clicking again.
